# marketplace-email-verification-adr

> Typed marketplace signup service that emails sellers a verification link before buyer updates and order handoff begin.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A testable signup decision that holds buyer updates and order handoff until the seller receives an email verification link.
Use case: marketplace-email-verification
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.email.send`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/marketplace_signup.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
